DIALOG: 
BODY: Thank you for your patience and understanding.

Our Stop & Shop website and app are currently unavailable, and we’re working to restore service as quickly as possible.

We know you count on us to make shopping easy and convenient, and we’re sorry for the disruption.

In the meantime, you can continue to shop Stop & Shop through DoorDash, Instacart, or Uber Eats.

Stop & Shop stores, pharmacies, and fuel stations remain open during normal business hours.

Thank you for being a Stop & Shop customer. We truly appreciate your patience and understanding while we work to get things back up and running.

Shop us on DoorDash
